entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: Event on Tarkir around 3282 AR in which the khans submitted to the dragonlords.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Plane of the clans and dragons.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Planeswalker who traveled back in time to save Ugin and sealed him in a hedron crucible.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: Dragon sealed in a hedron crucible; his dragonstorms blazed across Tarkir.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Twin brother of Ugin who would have killed him.

entities.name: Shu Yun
entities.description: Jeskai khan who allowed Ojutai to kill him.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord who demanded the death of dragon slayers.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Temur who cared only for hunting.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragonlord of the Mardu who wanted to soar at speed.

entities.name: Tasigur
entities.description: Sultai khan who refused to submit.

entities.name: Silumgar
entities.description: Sultai dragonlord who made Tasigur's corpse a necklace decoration.

events.summary: Daghatar smashed the mace holding his ancestors' spirits and submitted to Dromoka.
events.quote: Daghatar of the Abzan Houses was the first to submit to his new dragonlord

events.summary: Shu Yun accepted Ojutai's price and allowed the dragonlord to kill him.
events.quote: Shu Yun accepted, allowing the dragonlord to kill him.

events.summary: Yasova appeased Atarka with a sacrifice of wild animals.
Alesha and her clan rode in the trail of Kolaghan.
events.quote: they rode out across the plains in the trail of Kolaghan

events.summary: Tasigur refused to submit and became a decorative corpse on Silumgar's necklace.
events.quote: he ended up becoming a decorative corpse for Silumgar 's necklace
